# Checkpoint 1

**Date:** 2026-10-01 · **Phase:** [[Phase-1-Piano]] (M1.5) · **Build under test:** `index.html` with `js/notes.js`, `synth.js`, `scope.js`, `keyboard.js`, `app.js`.

## What was tried, and how

Each flow below was walked through in the code (`js/app.js`, `js/keyboard.js`, `js/synth.js`, `js/scope.js`) as a user would meet it, and compared with [[Keyboard]], [[Sound]], [[Oscilloscope]] and [[Business-Rules]]. `node --test tests/*.test.js` passes (40 tests). **No browser was driven in this pass**, so nothing about how it sounds or looks is claimed; that is the owner's check at the end.

## Flow by flow

| Flow | What happens | Verdict |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| Single note | `keydown` → `ensureAudio` → `noteOn` → key lit, readout `C4`; `keyup` → 150 ms fade, readout `—`. | Matches canon. |
| Chord | Each key is its own holder set; the readout lists names in press order; each note has its own voice. | Matches canon. |
| Holding a key | Repeats arrive with `repeat === true` and are dropped after `preventDefault` (K6, rule 7); `noteOn` is also idempotent. | Matches canon. |
| Waveform switch while playing | `change` → `setWaveform` sets `type` on every sounding voice, fading ones too (S6). Before audio exists, the choice is applied when the synth is created. | Matches canon. Finding F5. |
| Clicking keys | `pointerdown` (primary button) plays; `pointerup`, `pointerleave`, `pointercancel` release; no `pointerenter` handler, so K10 holds; `touch-action: none` is set. | Matches canon. Findings F4, F6. |
| Dragging off a key | `pointerleave` releases at once (K9). After a blur, the stale `held` entry in `keyboard.js` only produces a release the app ignores. | Matches canon. |
| Alt-Tab while holding | `blur` and `visibilitychange` call `releaseAll`: voices fade, `active` cleared, readout `—` (K14). On return, the still-held key only sends repeats, which are ignored, so nothing sounds until it is pressed again. | Matches canon. Finding F7. |
| First key before audio exists | The context is created inside the `keydown` (a user gesture), the synth and scope are built, `resume()` is called if suspended, then the note starts. | Matches canon. Finding F8. |
| No Web Audio | `#error` is shown at load; presses still light keys and update the readout; the scope stays flat (S9, rule 5). | Matches canon. Finding F9. |
